item.title: Snitch – A friendlier ss/netstat
item.description:
📝 snitch ls # styled table (default) snitch ls -l # listening only snitch ls -t -l # tcp listeners snitch ls -e # established only snitch ls -p # plain/parsable output snitch ls -o json # json output snitch ls -o csv # csv output snitch ls -n # numeric (no dns resolution) snitch ls --no-headers # omit headers snitch json json output for scripting. snitch json snitch json -l snitch watch stream json frames at an interval. snitch upgrade # check for updates snitch upgrade --yes # upgrade automatically snitch upgrade -v 0.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/karol-broda/snitch

item.title: The 60 Minutes report that Bari Weiss censored is now internet contraband
item.description:

Many of the people who were deported were awaiting asylum cases, according to The New York Times. Weiss claimed on an editorial call on Monday that she “held that story because it wasn’t ready,” according to The Washington Post.
